title: It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston extends participatory budgeting deadline to Aug. 7, allowing residents extra time to suggest ideas for $2 million in city spending.
The city seeks one-time investment ideas under its authority, not requiring new staff, and addressing equity to support those most in need.
Residents can submit proposals via participate.boston.gov or by calling 617-635-3059, with community voting on finalists from Jan. 15 to Feb. 15.

title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit back-to-back home runs during the Red Sox's game against the Dodgers at Dodger Stadium.
Rafaela's homers came in the first and third innings, both off Dodgers' pitcher Yoshinobu Yamamoto.
Rafaela has now hit 14 home runs this season, including three homers during the current series against the Dodgers.

title: Red Sox reportedly attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz, turned down by Reds
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Boston Red Sox attempted to trade for Cincinnati Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz.
Boston's offer for De La Cruz was based largely on prospects but was not accepted by the Reds.
The Red Sox remain open to acquiring a shortstop before the trade deadline on August 3.

title: Drake Maye says his shoulder ‘feels great’ as Patriots training camp continues
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Drake Maye reports his shoulder feels great as Patriots training camp progresses in Foxborough.
Patriots improved offensive personnel, including A.J. Brown, to aid Maye's performance after February's Super Bowl loss.
Brown familiar with 90% of playbook since June 1 trade, enhancing the wide receiver room's competitiveness.

title: If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Boston Red Sox defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 5-4, bolstering their postseason hopes.
Ceddanne Rafaela played a key role, turning a 4-3 deficit into a 5-4 victory.
Despite player absences, the Red Sox displayed strong performances, indicating capability for playoff success.

title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela's go-ahead home run in the seventh inning helped the Boston Red Sox defeat the Los Angeles Dodgers 9-4.
Brayan Bello pitched four scoreless innings in relief, contributing significantly to the Red Sox's victory despite prior struggles as a starter.
The Red Sox's win was their 21st of July, marking the franchise's best record in any calendar month at 21-4.

title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Linebacker Gabe Jacas made his Patriots debut in a limited capacity during Day 7 of training camp.
The Patriots defense recorded two interceptions during Saturday's training camp session.
Undrafted rookie Tanner Arkin is gaining attention as a blocking tight end in Patriots camp.

title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Massachusetts to issue chip-enabled EBT cards statewide to combat SNAP benefit theft, starting August.
Nearly 1 million residents use EBT cards, accepted at 5,500 retailers, for $2.6 billion in SNAP benefits annually.
Updated EBT cards follow successful Worcester pilot, aiming to prevent fraud from skimming devices, not recipient misuse.

title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston City Hall now offers 'pet certificates' to couples who include pets in their wedding ceremony.
Mayor Michelle Wu introduced the initiative to officially welcome pets into newly united households.
The pet certificates, titled 'Family Companion Status Record', come from the City's 'Office of Scratches and Pets'.

title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Kevin Nealon will perform in Boston and Portsmouth, NH, with stops at The Wilbur and The Music Hall in August 2026.
Nealon's social media presence, noted for its humor, supports projects like his special 'Loose in the Crotch' on YouTube.
Discussing his career, Nealon speaks about his time on SNL and collaboration with Adam Sandler in numerous films.
